title: Final pressure after pumping
description: Essential Criteria: Must correctly calculate the gas pressure inside the container after 15 pumps, obtaining 2.5×10⁵ Pa.

title: Final remaining disinfectant volume
description: Essential Criteria: Must correctly calculate the volume of disinfectant remaining after spraying stops, obtaining 0.5 L.

title: Apply isothermal Boyle's law
description: Important Criteria: Must recognize and apply Boyle's law (pV = constant at constant temperature) for both pumping and spraying stages.

title: Correct initial gas volume
description: Important Criteria: Must correctly determine the initial total gas volume before pumping as 2.5 L (2 L container gas + 15×0.1 L pumped gas).

title: Identify final equilibrium condition
description: Important Criteria: Must recognize that spraying stops when internal gas pressure equals atmospheric pressure (10⁵ Pa).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Should maintain consistent volume units (L or m³) and pressure units (Pa) throughout calculations.

title: Sign or pressure direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if atmospheric pressure is incorrectly treated or if pressure differences are miscalculated.

title: Volume accounting mistake
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if failing to account for the 2 L of liquid reducing gas volume, or miscalculating pumped gas volume.
